Moderate Sequence-of-Returns Risk (89.4%)
The simulation shows a 89.4% survival probability over 30 years. In severe bear markets, there is a 10.6% risk of capital exhaustion.
Recommendation:
Earliest simulated depletion observed around Year 19. Reducing monthly withdrawal by 5-8% elevates your survival odds to >95%.
Multi-Country Diversification Active (40% US)
Blending Bucket 3 equities across 1 foreign markets reduced equity volatility drag by ~2.56% through low cross-country correlation and provides global purchasing power protection.
Rebalancing Friction & Net Capital Preservation
Over the simulation horizon, bucket-to-bucket rebalancing incurred ₹1.85 L in estimated rebalancing slippage/friction (0.15% rate), but protected 10 full years of uninterrupted cash flow without forced fire-sales.
